newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 90-day t-bill drops to 5.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 90-day t-bill drops to 5.49 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 90-day Bahrain treasury bills dropped to 5.49 percent from 5.54 percent last week when the bills were for 91 days, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Wednesday.
The average price of the bills, maturing on May 14, rose to 98.645 from 98.619 and the minimum price accepted was 98.644.
Banks submitted bids for 30.4 million dinars worth of bills, up from 20.9 million dinars last week.
The bills, offered on Wednesday instead of Monday because of a three-day official holiday, would be issued on Thursday. - Bahrain newsroom - 973-536187.
